title: Dharmendra's first love was Hamida, long before Hema Malini
description: Veteran actor Dharmendra revealed his first childhood crush on Hamida. She was his schoolteacher's daughter and older than him. Dharmendra wrote a poem expressing his innocent affection for her. The Partition of 1947 separated them, ending their connection. This memory remained vivid for the actor throughout his life.

title: Vijay flags off Le Mans race; Trisha Krishnan spotted
description: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay attended Silverstone to support Ajith Kumar's racing event. Vijay waved the green flag, officially starting the Michelin Le Mans Cup race. Actor Trisha Krishnan was also present at the circuit while filming in London. Ajith Kumar's team finished thirty-eighth overall after a challenging two-hour contest. The team currently holds twenty-one championship points after the Silverstone round.

title: Celine Dion starts her 26-day Paris residency on Saturday
description: Celine Dion has made a triumphant return to live performance following a two-year break, launching her residency in Paris. Her emotional opening night saw her wiping away tears as she thanked fans for their steadfast support and understanding. This concert symbolizes her first full show since the cancellation of her 2020 tour. Dion's residency is scheduled to continue with more performances until March 2027.

title: Alan Ritchson and wife Catherine confirm split after 20 years
description: In a heartfelt announcement, actor Alan Ritchson and his wife Catherine have decided to part ways after nearly two decades of marriage. They emphasized that their friendship remains a priority, especially for their three sons. Having met as teenagers and tied the knot in 2006, the couple has requested privacy as they navigate this new chapter. Ritchson had initiated divorce proceedings last December, with a brief reconciliation occurring in March.

title: Sreenath Bhasi confirms divorce after 10-year marriage
description: Actor Sreenath Bhasi confirmed his marriage has ended and he separated from his wife. He revealed this development during a recent interview while promoting his film. Bhasi is now living with his parents after the divorce and separation. He married Reethu Zachariah in 2016 after knowing her for years. The actor has upcoming films 'Orijinal' and 'Avarachan & Sons'.

title: Jeremy Thomas passes away at 77
description: The film industry mourns the loss of veteran producer Jeremy Thomas, who has passed away in his home. Renowned for his extraordinary work on timeless films such as The Last Emperor, Thomas's dedication spanned over fifty years and earned him nine Academy Awards. His mark on cinema was profound, leaving behind a legacy that inspired many. Colleagues and collaborators now share heartfelt tributes in remembrance of this industry gem.

title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay runs to hug Ajith Kumar
description: Tamil cinema stars Vijay and Ajith Kumar shared a rare reunion at Silverstone. Vijay approached Ajith Kumar at the racing circuit, which was captured in a viral video. Ajith Kumar competed in the Michelin Le Mans Cup race as part of his motorsport commitments. He expressed gratitude to Vijay for attending the event during his UK trip. Both actors have been leading figures in Tamil cinema for decades.

title: All about how Ian Somerhalder embraced the farm life after ‘The Vampire Diaries'
description: After wrapping up his Hollywood acting career, Ian Somerhalder sought solace in the simplicity of farm life with his family. A transformative journey to Zimbabwe ignited his commitment to regenerative farming, which he fervently advocates through various documentaries. In addition to this passion, he ventured into entrepreneurship by co-founding a bourbon brand and a health supplement company, aiming to promote a sustainable lifestyle.
